author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete the following amino acid metabolic process terms, see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31172:

GO:0035498 | carnosine metabolic process
GO:0006591 | ornithine metabolic process
GO:0006560 | L-proline metabolic process
GO:0006551 | L-leucine metabolic process
GO:0006525 | arginine metabolic process
GO:0006555 | L-methionine metabolic process
GO:0006544 | glycine metabolic process
GO:0006531 | aspartate metabolic process
GO:0006563 | L-serine metabolic process
GO:0050667 | homocysteine metabolic process
GO:0006536 | glutamate metabolic process

The reason for obsoletion is that these terms are unnecessary grouping terms; only the 'biosynthetic process' or 'catabolic process' terms should be used. 

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed (135) are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gSh38RbW0opEkYh1KWHwSVCC2C8-82FymkNiAb3C6nQ/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups (experimental annotations):

| Group | EXP 
|---|---
| UniProt | 75
| MGI | 32 
| TAIR | 12 
| MTBBASE | 4 
| AspGD | 2 
| ComplexPortal | 2 
| dictyBase | 2 
| ZFIN | 2 
| CAFA | 1 
| EcoCyc | 1 
| GeneDB | 1 
| PseudoCAP | 1 

Mappings that need to be reviewed:
- **InterPro2GO** (14 entries): IPR024904 (ornithine); IPR003964, IPR004636, IPR007079, IPR014033, IPR020900, IPR037031, IPR054924 (arginine); IPR002084, IPR003171, IPR004621 (methionine); IPR003437 (glycine); IPR004708 (aspartate); IPR010107 (glutamate). 
- **UniRule** (2): UR001996784 (arginine), UR001995779 (aspartate)
- **ARBA** (10): ARBA00091061, ARBA00033542, ARBA00026496, ARBA00026425, ARBA00026499, ARBA00085449, ARBA00085438, ARBA00044408, ARBA00089512, ARBA00085446. 

Note: 7 of these terms (ornithine, L-proline, arginine, L-methionine, glycine, aspartate, glutamate) were already in the earlier review #6062 . Groups that finished there may have nothing left; the sheet shows what GOlr still has.
title: Review annotations to amino acid metabolic process grouping terms (go-ontology#31172)
